reference.pathophysiology: Early temperament interacting with invalidating or traumatic environments derails emotion regulation and mentalisation development, entrenching interpersonal patterns that evoke confirming responses from others.

Avoidant personality versus social anxiety disorder severity and pervasiveness
OCPD perfectionism versus OCD intrusive rituals
additionalInvestigations: Longitudinal history from youth, collateral accounts
Structured personality assessment in specialist settings
Comorbidity and risk formulation at every contact
